text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon brilliantly conquers the 
Arima Kinen! Narita Brian also displayed 
fierce, sharp dominance, leaving the 
entire venue in raptures over the duel 
between the "Amazoness" and the "Monster."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Congratulated by Narita Brian, Hishi 
Amazon savored her victory. She lets out a 
roar of sheer joy from the fiery 
one-on-one duel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Narita Brian mentioned 
that Hishi Amazon possessed a burning heat 
that made her want to sink her teeth into 
it. Acknowledging one another, the two vow 
to have a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She burns with fiery resolve—no matter how 
many times they go head-to-head, she will 
win...!
